Is the frame regularly sampled?

Source: R/sampling.R
is_sampling_regular.Rd

Every gap between consecutive observations equal, within tolerance. Computed from the data each time it is asked rather than recorded, because dropping rows changes the answer and a stored logical would go on claiming the old one.

Usage

is_sampling_regular(data, tolerance = 1e-06)

Arguments

data

An anipoint object.

tolerance

Relative tolerance: a gap counts as equal to the interval when it differs by no more than tolerance * interval. Timestamps are rarely exactly equal, so comparing them with == says "irregular" for data that is regular to any precision that matters. Raise it for noisy timestamps, lower it to be strict.

Value

TRUE, FALSE, or NA when the frame is too short to tell.

See also

get_sampling_interval()

Examples

af <- example_anipoint(n_obs = 5, n_individuals = 2, n_keypoints = 1)
is_sampling_regular(af)
#> [1] TRUE

# A gap in the recording
irregular <- af |> dplyr::filter(time != 3)
is_sampling_regular(irregular)
#> [1] FALSE
